subject: Solar Pump Subsidy (Mukhyamantri Saur Krushi Pump Yojana)
summary: 95% subsidy on solar agricultural pumps (3HP/5HP/7.5HP). 3HP pump costing 2,25,000 available for 11,250. Priority for Vidarbha/Marathwada farmers without electricity. Apply through MahaDBT portal.

subject: Crop Loss Compensation - Unseasonal Rains (Shetkari Sankat Nidhi)
summary: 842 crore sanctioned for crop loss compensation. Rates: 13600/ha Kharif crops, 18000/ha horticulture, 25000/ha grape/pomegranate. Report via e-Peek Pahani within 72 hours. Direct bank transfer within 45 days.
beneficiaries: All affected farmers with e-Peek Pahani registration

subject: Farm Loan Waiver Extension (MJPSKY 2024)
summary: Loan waiver for crop loans up to 2 lakh from cooperative/nationalized banks (April 2020-March 2024). Regular repayers get 50000 incentive bonus. Apply through MJPSKY portal by Sept 30 2024.
beneficiaries: Farmers with crop loans up to 2 lakh
amount: Full waiver up to 2 lakh + 50000 incentive

subject: Subsidized Drip Irrigation (PMKSY Micro Irrigation)
summary: Increased subsidy for drip/sprinkler irrigation. General category: 55% subsidy, SC/ST/small farmers: 70% subsidy. Covers drip, sprinkler, rain guns. Max 5 hectares per farmer. Apply through MahaDBT.

subject: Free Seed Kit Distribution Kharif 2024 (Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti)
summary: Free seed kits: 10kg soybean + 2kg tur + 5kg green manure + 50kg DAP at 50% subsidy for tribal/SC farmers. From June 1 via Krishi Seva Kendras. Carry Aadhaar, 7/12, caste certificate.
districts: Nashik, Thane, Palghar, Nandurbar, Gadchiroli, Chandrapur, Gondia

subject: KCC Interest Subvention - 1% Additional for Prompt Repayers
summary: Additional 1% state interest subvention for timely KCC repayers, making effective rate 3% p.a. For loans up to 3 lakh from cooperative/nationalized banks. Auto-credited on timely repayment.
beneficiaries: KCC holders with loans up to 3 lakh

subject: Namo Shetkari Maha Samman Nidhi - State Top-Up to PM-KISAN
summary: Additional 6000/year on top of PM-KISAN 6000, total 12000/year. Three installments of 2000 each (April/August/December). Auto-eligible if registered under PM-KISAN. New registrations at CSC centers.

subject: PoCRA Phase-II (Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Yojana)
summary: 6000 crore budget for 2025-2030. Farm pond subsidy up to 75000, shade net 50% up to 5 lakh, polyhouse 50% up to 28 lakh, free vermicompost unit. Target: 15 lakh farmers in drought-prone zones.
amount: 75000 for ponds to 28 lakh for polyhouses

subject: Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana - Enhanced to 2100/month
summary: Monthly allowance increased from 1500 to 2100 effective April 2025. For women aged 21-65 with family income under 2.5 lakh. Farming families with <2.5 acres get priority. Apply via Narishakti Doot App.

subject: Organic Farming Promotion and Certification Subsidy
summary: 100% subsidy on organic certification (up to 20000 per group) and 12500/ha/year incentive for 3 years transition period. Min 25 farmers, 50 hectares contiguous. Training through KVKs. Inputs at 50% subsidy.
beneficiaries: Farmer groups of 25+ with 50+ hectare contiguous area

subject: Godown and Cold Storage Construction Subsidy (RKVY)
summary: 50% subsidy up to 3.5 lakh for farm godowns (50-500 quintal). 40% subsidy up to 35 lakh for cold storage (5000+ quintal). Priority for FPOs with 100+ members. Apply through National Horticulture Board.

subject: Agricultural Electricity Tariff Subsidy - Flat Rate
summary: Flat rate 1.80/unit for metered agricultural connections. Unmetered: 97.50/HP/month. 5000 incentive for converting to metered. New connections within 90 days at MSEDCL office.

subject: Sugarcane FRP and SAP for 2025-26 Season
summary: FRP fixed at 340/quintal at 10.25% recovery. Additional 3.40/quintal per 0.1% recovery above 10.25%. State SAP: 3500/tonne. Factories must pay within 14 days. Delayed payment: 15% interest.
districts: Pune, Satara, Kolhapur, Sangli, Solapur, Ahmednagar

subject: Animal Husbandry - Dairy and Poultry Unit Subsidy
summary: 2 lakh subsidy for mini-dairy (2-10 cows), 1.5 lakh for poultry (500-1000 birds). SC/ST: 75% subsidy, general: 50%. Includes free AI services, vet camps. Training mandatory at KVK/vet college.

subject: Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan 2.0 - Farm Water Conservation
summary: 1 crore per village for deepening nullahs, cement nala bunds, farm ponds (30mx30mx3m), recharge shafts. Farmer contribution 10% (waived for SC/ST). 5000 villages/year target. MGNREGA convergence for labor.
amount: 1 crore/village, farm pond subsidy up to 75000
